_schema.description: Append-only audit ledger of drift between docdd-starters' .claude/ tree and upstream reference harness. Each baseline snapshot is an entry in baselines[]. Each drift record is an entry in records[] and points to its baseline via baseline_id. summary[] caches per-baseline counts. v0.2+ MUST append to all three arrays without rewriting existing entries.

baselines[].captured_at: YYYY-MM-DD ISO date the snapshot was taken
baselines[].captured_by_issue: GitHub Issue number that produced this snapshot

records[].change_type: added | removed | modified (upstream-relative; same-sha files are not records)
records[].upstream_sha256: sha256 of the file in upstream at baseline; null if change_type=removed
records[].local_sha256: sha256 of the file locally; null if change_type=added
records[].classification: Adopt now | Adapt later | Document only | Reject

evaluation.fork_immediacy: high | mid | low | null (null = deferred to per-Wave Issue)

records[].target_wave: W1 | W2 | W3 | W4 | Finish | null (null for Reject / Document only)
records[].reevaluation_trigger: string; required when classification=Reject (use 'N/A — ...' for permanent rejects)
records[].reject_category: optional; Reject 既定 category label for traceability

summary[].total_count: int (sum of the four counts above)

_schema.evaluation_axis: fork_immediacy × genericity × core_coupling ÷ maintenance_cost. Per-item scores are only filled for items that received explicit human review (TOP10 candidates). Mass-classified items via Reject 既定 / category fallback have evaluation=null and rely on the rule label in 'notes' for traceability.
_schema.append_only_rule: v0.2+ MUST not mutate existing baselines[], records[], or summary[] entries. New snapshots add a new baselines[] entry, append new records[], and append a new summary[]. Re-classification of an existing path requires emitting a NEW record under the new baseline_id.
